policy.sameConcept: Use only when two maintained records represent the same scientific concept. The source record remains independently addressable; its destination is added to the canonical concept.
policy.contextOnly: Use when a maintained object is a meaningful occurrence or application context of a concept but is not another definition of that concept.
policy.keepSeparate: Scientifically related concepts remain distinct canonical concepts and must never be merged merely because their terminology overlaps.
